claims.claim: A miniature San Francisco simulation with real buses, planes, boats, weather, and robotaxis runs in any web browser at smallsf.com.
claims.episode_span: A developer named ari dutilh built a small, working version of San Francisco that loads directly in any web browser. Real buses move on actual routes, planes take off and land, boats travel the water, and the weather changes over time. You can even hop into a robotaxi and ride around the miniature streets.
claims.supporting_quote: I built a miniature San Francisco that runs in your browser. Real buses, planes, boats, and weather. Plus robotaxis you can ride! smallsf.com

claims.claim: Sir Geoffrey Vos asked ChatGPT how Article 8 of the ECHR should be amended to protect against cyber-fakes and received an essay with three additional sub-clauses.
claims.episode_span: Sir Geoffrey Vos typed a question about protecting people from digital fakes into ChatGPT and received a full essay plus three new legal clauses in reply.
claims.source_title: AI and human rights: Sir Geoffrey consults ChatGPT
claims.supporting_quote: I asked ChatGPT how article 8 should be amended to protect citizens against cyber-fakes and was presented with an extraordinary essay, including the detailed drafting for three additional sub-clauses to protect against digital impersonation and fabrication.

claims.claim: In tests by the Center for Countering Digital Harm, 41 percent of direct queries to teen ChatGPT accounts received harmful responses, rising to 82 percent when framed as homework.
claims.episode_span: In tests by the Center for Countering Digital Harm, 41 percent of direct queries received harmful responses, rising to 82 percent when the requests were framed as homework, research, or fiction writing.
claims.supporting_quote: Some 41% of the Center for Countering Digital Harm’s (CCDH) tests of the AI chatbot resulted in harmful responses
